clue.text: Prepared for wet weather in Burgundy

definitions.meaning: someone with a mackintosh on is ready for rain
a red or white wine from the Mâconnais district of Burgundy

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as MAC ON: wearing a raincoat. 'in' is just a link to the second definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The town gives its name to a wine of the Burgundy region, and a mac being on means a raincoat is worn.

clue.text: Assimilate a synopsis

definitions.meaning: to take in and absorb food or ideas
a summary or condensed account

explanation.definitionFit: To absorb food or knowledge is the verb sense; a condensed summary is the noun sense.

clue.text: An Italian of vulgar nature is seldom seen

parts.note: the Italian word for 'a' or 'an' is un
common means coarse or lacking refinement

explanation.surface: A coarse Italian is a rare sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rarely encountered is unusual or rare.

clue.text: At the end of the day, no-one's in the dark

definitions.text: At the end of the day
definitions.meaning: an idiom meaning when everything is taken into account, in total
if every person has been informed, nobody remains ignorant

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads the answer literally: everybody has been informed.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in total or all things considered; literally, every person has been informed so nobody lacks knowledge.

clue.text: Adroitly adapted for worship

indicators.note: something adapted has been altered and rearranged, so the letters of the preceding word are reworked

explanation.walkthrough: 'adapted' rearranges ADROITLY; 'for' is a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Idol veneration is a form of devotion, the excessive reverence of images.

clue.text: They depend on people wanting earrings?

definitions.text: They depend on people wanting earrings?

parts.words: They depend on people wanting earrings?
parts.note: dangling earrings are hangers, and people wanting them would like hangers put on their ears; the real sense is dependants or sycophants

explanation.walkthrough: The real sense is hangers-on, people who cling to someone else for advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: Followers who attach themselves to a rich or famous person for gain are parasitic dependants.

clue.text: Basic reason for murdering a relation

indicators.note: to murder something is to mangle or ruin it, so the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: The fundamental motive for killing a family member.
explanation.walkthrough: 'murdering' rearranges A RELATION; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The underlying logical grounds for an action are its basis or justification.

clue.text: Perfect way for a trader to define his occupation

definitions.meaning: flawless, as good as can be

definitions.text: way for a trader to define his occupation
definitions.meaning: a dealer describing his job might say '...'

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as I DEAL for the second, whimsical definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flawless is the model one wishes for; a dealer describing his work would say he deals.

clue.text: A taste of early Chinese ceramics

definitions.meaning: a sharp, distinctive flavour
pottery of the ... dynasty, which ruled China from 618 to 907

explanation.definitionFit: A strong flavour or tinge; also the medieval Chinese dynasty famous for glazed pottery figures.

clue.text: Leading physician settled in wooded area

indicators.note: the doctor has settled inside, so one word sits within the other

parts.note: a forest is a large wooded area
MO is short for medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A top doctor has moved into a house in the woods.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming first in rank or position, the most prominent.

clue.text: Claim to see member in porter's embrace

indicators.note: the member sits inside the porter, so one word goes within another
being held in an embrace means being enclosed, confirming the container

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, a type of ale
a leg is a limb, or member, of the body

explanation.surface: Someone says they saw a limb wrapped in a hotel porter's arms.
explanation.walkthrough: Porter is a dark beer, not a doorman; 'to see' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To assert something without proof is to state it as a charge.

clue.text: Check the family tree

definitions.meaning: to stop or stanch a flow
the main line of descent in a lineage

explanation.definitionFit: To halt a flow, as of blood; also the main ancestral line of descent in a genealogy.

clue.text: They set fire to barges

definitions.meaning: devices or people that ignite things
flat-bottomed boats used to carry cargo to and from ships

explanation.definitionFit: Ignition devices for cigarettes; also flat-bottomed cargo boats used in harbours.

clue.text: Given legal power, albeit with reservations

definitions.meaning: entitled or competent to act by law
limited or modified by conditions, as in a guarded statement

explanation.definitionFit: Officially competent or licensed; also restricted by conditions, as with guarded approval.

clue.text: Only a fool serves spirit in beakers

indicators.note: the spirit is placed inside the beakers, one word within the other

parts.note: mugs are drinking vessels, like beakers
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Only an idiot serves liquor in lab glassware.
explanation.walkthrough: 'serves' is a link. The definition is British slang for a gullible person, often said of oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: Muggins is British slang for a dupe, often said ruefully of oneself as the only one silly enough.

clue.text: Some rags converted into fine fabric

indicators.note: something converted is changed into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A few rags are transformed into delicate cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converted' rearranges SOME RAGS; 'into' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A very fine, filmy gauze, named after the cobweb threads it resembles.

clue.text: Libertine youth giving dramatic performance?

parts.note: a play is a drama staged in a theatre
a boy is a young male

explanation.surface: A rakish young man is putting on a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A wealthy pleasure-seeking man devoted to women and luxury is a rake or roué.

clue.text: Drilling manoeuvre effected by renegade Tory?

definitions.meaning: a soldier on the parade ground turns on command
a Conservative who defects to the left of politics has swung leftward

explanation.walkthrough: Tories are the UK Conservatives, on the political right; one who deserts goes the other way. 'effected by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A parade-ground drill command to face ninety degrees anticlockwise; also a politician's swing away from the right.

clue.text: Abraham's son cooked his meal

indicators.note: cooked suggests the words are prepared and mixed up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A biblical patriarch's boy prepared his supper.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, the patriarch's first son, born to Hagar, is the ancestor of Arab peoples.

clue.text: Outstanding works by Lewis offered to Form One

indicators.note: the author's initials are offered to, so placed after, the form and number

parts.note: a form is a school class
I is the Roman numeral for one
C. S. Lewis, author of the Narnia books

explanation.surface: Fine books by a famous author are given to the first-year pupils.
explanation.walkthrough: In British schools a form is a class year; 'by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Works of enduring excellence are acknowledged masterpieces of literature.

clue.text: Stylish redhead acquires round pill-box

parts.note: in means fashionable
the head, or first letter, of red is R
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A fashionable red-haired woman picks up a round hat.
explanation.walkthrough: A pill-box seems to be a hat; it is a small Japanese case for medicines. 'acquires' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An inro is a small Japanese case of compartments, hung from the sash, for medicines or seals.

clue.text: Confront fellow-expert

parts.note: an ace is someone highly skilled

explanation.surface: Stand up to a colleague who is a specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet a challenge head-on is to stand up to it.

clue.text: Immature airman returned in state of depression

indicators.note: returned means the word for the airman is read backwards

parts.note: LAC is a leading aircraftman in the RAF
low means downcast, depressed

explanation.surface: A green airman came back feeling down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns LAC (leading aircraftman, an RAF rank) into CAL; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Inexperienced and lacking adult judgment, like an unfledged bird.

clue.text: Diminutive farm animal belonging to me

parts.note: a pig is a farm animal
my is the possessive of me

explanation.definitionFit: A variant of pygmy, describing something very small of its kind.

clue.text: Liaison generates concern

definitions.meaning: a romantic or sexual relationship
a matter or business that is someone's responsibility

explanation.definitionFit: A love relationship outside marriage; also a matter or piece of business.

clue.text: Encountered everyone in charge of minerals

parts.note: met means encountered
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Met everybody who runs the mining operation.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to metal ores; metal-bearing substances are minerals.

clue.text: Father means to live. Understand?

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
to get something is to understand it

explanation.surface: A dad explains what it means to be alive and asks if you follow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Father' is the verb, to sire; 'means' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To sire or procreate offspring, as in the biblical genealogies.

clue.text: Successor suddenly surfaces to get objets d'art

parts.note: an heir succeeds to an estate
something looms when it appears suddenly and threateningly

explanation.surface: An heir appears abruptly to claim the valuables.
explanation.definitionFit: Family treasures handed down through generations are often valuable art or antiques.
